listitem.para: The access level needed to see the other users in the lists of users of filters and fields, and in searches for users. Below it, a user is only offered themselves. The default is ANYBODY, which lists every user that can have the role the field is for (for example every user that can report issues, in the list of reporters of the filter), so on a tracker that is open to customers they can see each other: raise it to prevent that.

When more users than this can be chosen in the Reporter, Monitored By and Note By fields of the filter, they are searched for as the user types instead of being listed in a drop-down, which is slow to load and hard to use with thousands of users. 0, the default, always lists them. Without JavaScript such a field only has the users that are selected, so a filter can be kept or cleared but not changed.
The number of searches for users that a user may make per minute. It defaults to 120, 0 means no limit.
The threshold for a user to be able to impersonate another user, or NOBODY to disable impersonation. Default ADMINISTRATOR.
The threshold for a user to manage user accounts. Default ADMINISTRATOR.
